table.name: TLGNC_DRIVER_WAITINGREASON
table.description: Stores reasons for truck drivers waiting at shippingpoints or shiptos.

column.name: DRIVER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_driver. Driver ID, to which this record is related.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Either Shippingpoint or Shipto is set depending on if the driver had to wait on shippingpoint or shipto.

column.name: SHIPTO_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto. Either Shippingpoint or Shipto is set depending on if the driver had to wait on shippingpoint or shipto.

column.name: waittime_min
column.description: timespan after which the reason had to be entered (configurable value).

column.name: EVENT_TS
column.description: Creation Timestamp (Date and Time) of the event a) in the original system/PDA (if available/sent) or b) set to 'now' by Logon when receiving/storing the event. This is the main time information about when the event actually occurred.
